metadata.description: Water's personal collection of AI skills, featuring content publishing, information collection, trend analysis, app review insights, magazine-style deck generation, course PPTX building, wiki building, project harness generation, resume screening, multi-platform OpenCLI publishing, SEO/GEO content writing, multi-style comic/infographic prompt generation, and a four-skill video creation pipeline (screenwriting, directing, production prompt cards, and FFmpeg editing).

plugins.name: wtt-auto-poster-skills
plugins.description: Automated content publishing to Zhihu and WeChat Official Account with Mac-style code blocks and smart image handling.

plugins.name: wtt-info-collector-skills
plugins.description: Config-driven information collection framework with modular data sources and automated report generation.

plugins.name: wtt-trend-radar-skills
plugins.description: Multi-platform real-time trend aggregation and analysis across 11+ platforms with keyword filtering.

plugins.name: wtt-app-review-insights-skills
plugins.description: App Store review insights analyzer that extracts pain points, opportunities, user segments, and actionable recommendations.

plugins.name: wtt-magazine-deck-skills
plugins.description: Magazine-style HTML deck generator for editorial and swiss presentation systems with self-contained output.

plugins.name: wtt-course-pptx-builder-skills
plugins.description: AI-driven course PPTX builder that converts source documents into high-quality SVG slides and exports them to PPTX.

plugins.name: wtt-llm-wiki-builder-skills
plugins.description: Build, compile, and maintain LLM-friendly wiki knowledge bases from scattered markdown files.

plugins.name: wtt-project-harness-generator-skills
plugins.description: Scan project DNA and generate CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and rules with coding discipline, UI/UX, and architecture conventions.

plugins.name: wtt-resume-screener-skills
plugins.description: Config-driven resume screening with level-adaptive evaluation standards, HR + hiring-manager dual-perspective AI review, and Markdown screening reports.

plugins.name: wtt-post-geo-skills
plugins.description: Multi-platform GEO publishing across WeChat Official Account, Weibo, Zhihu Column, CSDN, Juejin, Baijiahao, Cnblogs, Xiaohongshu and Twitter/X with a layered official-API / browser-login-adapter / OpenCLI fallback route, unified format adaptation, GEO link surfacing, media constraints, status verification and precise reporting.

plugins.name: wtt-seo-geo-writer-skills
plugins.description: Converts input content into SEO- or GEO-optimized Markdown articles on two main paths; vertical profiles (e.g. 9day.tech, Beidou9, fortune-telling) are opt-in and loaded only when explicitly requested.

plugins.name: wtt-nine-comic-imagegen-skills
plugins.description: Multi-style comic and infographic image-prompt generation across five styles (nine-comic parody explainer, cartoon infographic, four-panel cute comic, Klein-blue line figure, vibe lifestyle portrait) with Chinese-first prompts for ChatGPT, Jimeng, and Midjourney.

plugins.name: wtt-code-video-studio-skills
plugins.description: Code video studio: turns ideas, articles, or scripts into front-end code animations and MP4s; recommends five directions per piece, shows a four-frame contact sheet for user confirmation, then renders fully and delivers with narration-calibrated timing. Covers concept explanation (text, static diagrams, interactive HTML), personal promo, product tutorials, documentary, data stories, and map postcards, with default personal narration, stable per-character voices, per-utterance performance instructions on supported backends, and asset version review. Ships an original handpainted-cinema character animation source template (V2 craft), maps use cases to style candidates, and carries a research-only reference case library with style fidelity checks.

plugins.name: wtt-fin-chart-skills
plugins.description: Turns financial data, KPIs, spreadsheets (CSV/Excel), and investor materials into insight-rich HTML financial charts, dashboards, operating analysis pages, and board-ready interactive data stories, with long-screenshot PNG backups.

plugins.name: wtt-kindle-revive-skills
plugins.description: Kindle 检查、备份、固定组件部署维护与 USB/Wi-Fi 导书；WTT Reader 复用 KOReader、微信读书插件和 SSH/SFTP。首台 PW1 已有本地及微信正文阅读反馈，真机无线传书仍待验收。

plugins.name: wtt-video-screenwriter-skills
plugins.description: Screenwriter: develops ideas, material, or existing stories into serialized shorts, complete short films, and standalone episodes, delivering story briefs, characters, outlines, shootable scripts, and three-pass review; storyboards go to directing and asset/video prompts to production.

plugins.name: wtt-video-director-skills
plugins.description: Director: turns scripts, stories, or reference images into storyboards, spatial lighting and color, shot language, voice performance, and asset requirements; final image/video prompts and production packs are handed to the producer skill or any production workflow.

plugins.name: wtt-video-producer-skills
plugins.description: Producer: organizes storyboards into per-character, per-scene, and per-segment prompt cards plus one shared keyframe card, with a master index mapping assets, usage, and versions; delivers text production packs by default and drives real generation only with explicit authorization.

plugins.name: wtt-video-editor-skills
plugins.description: Editor: joins existing footage or generated clips into a playable MP4 with FFmpeg — probing head/tail contact frames, trimming duplicated motion, handling transitions and audio continuity — and delivers an edit plan documenting every cut.
